dmn_experiences.title: The Liverpool Craft Beer Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided craft beer tour visiting two Liverpool microbreweries and two beer-focused pubs, with tutored tastings and the chance to meet the brewers. A beer expert explains the ingredients and brewing techniques along the way.
highlights: Behind-the-scenes visits to two microbreweries
Tutored tastings across a range of beer styles
Meet the brewers
Roughly 1.5 miles of mostly flat walking
Suitable for newcomers and enthusiasts alike

dmn_experiences.title: Liverpool Beer Tasting Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A two-hour guided craft beer tasting taking in two of Liverpool's best beer venues, starting at The Dead Crafty Beer Company. A beer expert leads tastings of local and world beers with table service throughout.
highlights: Seven third-pint tastings included
Expert-led guidance on styles and brewing
Reserved tables with table service at each venue
Visits two of the city's best beer spots
Step-free, accessible venues

dmn_experiences.title: Bottomless Brewery Tours Liverpool
dmn_experiences.summary: A behind-the-scenes tour of Liverpool's historic Cains brewery in the Baltic Triangle, followed by 90 minutes of bottomless Cains beers and nibbles.
highlights: Guided tour of the historic Cains brewery
90 minutes of bottomless Cains beers
Nibbles included
Learn the brewing process and brewery heritage
Saturday 1pm slots; weekday options for groups of eight or more

dmn_experiences.title: Top Rope Brewing Brewery Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Top Rope Brewing led by the head brewer, following beer from grain to glass. It ends with a tutored tasting and pizza in the taproom.
highlights: Guided tour with head brewer Ben Jackson
Four and a half pints plus pizza included
See the raw ingredients up close
10% off takeaway cans
Finishes in the taproom
